description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractModelEvent' within the Goteo project, extending Symfony's Event class. It includes methods for handling a model object and checks if the model matches a specified name.

classes.name: AbstractModelEvent
classes.description: An abstract event class that encapsulates a Model object and provides methods to interact with it.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with an optional model object.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the model associated with this event.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the model's table name matches the provided string, case-insensitive.
